paper: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), 'Time series momentum', JFE, PDF p.10: EWMA vol with center of mass delta/(1-delta)=60 days, factor 261; PDF p.14: strategy return sign(r_{t-12,t}) * target/sigma_{t-1}; target 40%.
level: L2 (own build on Yahoo continuous futures vs L1 AQR factor)

ours.license: Yahoo Finance terms of use; personal/research use, not redistributable
known_biases: survivorship: today's listings only; delisted firms absent
unofficial API: no SLA, silent errors possible
adjusted history is revised between downloads

aqr.source: AQR Time Series Momentum factors (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen)
aqr.license: Terms of use are in the spreadsheet's own tab; credit AQR Capital Management

disclosures: Survivorship bias: the cache holds today's listings only; delisted and bankrupt firms are absent, so equity backtests are biased upward.
Continuous front-month series are not delisting-prone, but the contract set is today's.
Coverage: 21 commodity instruments obtained vs 24 commodities (58 instruments total) in the paper.
Yahoo continuous front-month futures are NOT roll-adjusted: roll gaps enter as spurious returns, adding noise and bias.
Breadth: far fewer instruments than the paper, so portfolio vol and diversification differ.

table.note: Reference = AQR commodity TSMOM (24 commodities, roll-adjusted, own vol scaling).
AQR column = TSMOM^CM Sharpe over same months

notes: The paper's Fig. 2 gives per-instrument Sharpe ratios graphically; no commodity-only or diversified Sharpe number was found in text, so no paper-reported figure is compared.
Reference is AQR's replication data, not the paper's own CSV.
